correctness.rationale: For cubic graphs the published representative lemma bounds arbitrary optimal colorings by feasible matching and singleton pairs, and each feasible pair is itself a valid reduced coloring. Exact per-column weight and the successor-zero lemma give the sharp cyclic maximum n. The 17-symbol local model yields a bijection with every reduced optimum for \(n\ge3\); the 119-state graph is assembled directly from local validity and exact equality. Its three cyclic SCC spectra are independently recomputed with integer traces/Newton identities in the standalone script, proving the rational determinant identity and infinite enumerator. Original-graph exhaustive enumeration for \(n=3,4,5,6\) produces 16,65,151,434; finite checks are corroborative, not extrapolation. Limits: larger color classes not counted.

value.rationale: The natural unlabelled class partition multiplicity among reduced (singleton and matching-pair) colorings is not determined by maximum palette results. The compact rational series, explicit recurrence factors of degrees 5 and 7, and complete optimal cyclic local-language characterization quantify the structural diversity of all such extremizers for every size. No artificial finite slice is chosen; every labelled circular ladder \(n\ge3\) is covered.
